_comment: Configuration for streaming multi-camera mosaic video processor
_description: Creates mosaicked video from synchronized camera sources using single-pass processing

input._video_dir_description: Directory containing video files or NVR subdirectories

_mode_options.all: Select all cameras from calibration file (24 cameras total)
_mode_options.list: Explicit list of camera IDs (compatible with GUI checkboxes)
_mode_options.exclude: All cameras except those in exclude list
_mode_options.spatial: Select cameras by spatial bounds (future feature for GUI)

camera_selection._cameras_description: Used when mode='list'. List of camera IDs to include
camera_selection._cameras_note: Must match calibration CSV exactly. Check: head -1 calibration/camera_calibrations_YYYYMMDD.csv
camera_selection._exclude_description: Used when mode='exclude'. Cameras to skip
camera_selection._spatial_bounds_description: Used when mode='spatial'. Geographic bounds for camera selection (future)

error_handling._skip_missing_calibration_description: If true, skip cameras without calibration. If false (recommended), fail with error
error_handling._skip_missing_cache_description: If true, skip cameras without ortho cache at requested resolution. If false (recommended), fail with error
error_handling._skip_missing_videos_description: If true (recommended), process available cameras even if some have no videos. If false, require all cameras to have videos
error_handling._min_cameras_required_description: Minimum number of cameras needed to proceed (after filtering)

input._backward_compatibility_note: Old format 'camera_ids: [...]' still supported and will be auto-migrated to 'camera_selection: {mode: list, cameras: [...]}'
input._interval_seconds_description: Time between frames in seconds (1.0-2.0 recommended for PIV analysis)
input._interval_seconds_note: Smaller intervals = more frames = longer processing time

paths._comment: File paths for calibration and reference data
paths._calibration_file_description: Camera calibrations CSV file with ortho caches
paths._dsm_file_description: Digital surface model (not directly used, but referenced by calibrations)

processing._ortho_resolution_note: Must match ortho cache resolution. Run orthorectification first to generate caches.
processing._mosaic_method_description: zone_map = use shapefile zones (recommended), center = blend by distance from center
processing._zone_map_shapefile_description: Path to zone map shapefile (required if mosaic_method=zone_map)
processing._rotation_angle_deg_description: Rotation angle in degrees (counterclockwise). Use 78.1 for model_to_world alignment
processing._rotation_angle_deg_note: Rotates video frames without scaling. 0.0 = no rotation, 78.1 = match model_to_world_20251120.wld
processing._clip_shapefile_description: Optional shapefile to clip mosaic to analysis area (e.g., analysis/analysis_shapefiles/general_analysis_limits.shp)
processing._clip_shapefile_note: Clipping happens after mosaicking but before rotation. Set to null to disable

output._output_dir_description: Directory for output video and metadata
output._video_fps_description: Frames per second for output video
output._video_fps_note: Higher FPS = smoother playback, larger file size

camera_time_offsets._description: If one NVR's videos are ahead/behind, adjust here

_usage_notes._quick_test: For quick test: use --quick flag to process only 30 seconds
_usage_notes._typical_2min: 2 minutes @ 1 sec interval: 120 frames, ~10-15 seconds processing
_usage_notes._performance: 6-12x faster than TIFF approach, 10-60x less storage
_usage_notes._prerequisites: Must have ortho caches generated at specified resolution first

quick_test_30sec.description: Quick 30-second test of NVR1 cameras 4 and 5

_workflow.1_generate_caches: First run orthorectification to generate ortho caches
_workflow.2_copy_config: Copy this template and edit camera_ids, times, paths
